checked_obligation: Verify that multiplying the norm −2 solution 1+√3 by nonnegative powers of the norm 1 element 2+√3 produces integer-coefficient elements of norm −2.
reason: In Z[√3], N(u+v√3)=u²−3v² and direct expansion gives N(αβ)=N(α)N(β). Since N(1+√3)=−2 and N(2+√3)=1, N((1+√3)(2+√3)^k)=−2 for every integer k≥0; closure of Z[√3] under multiplication ensures integral coefficients. The listed quotient and isomorphism rules are irrelevant.
